critical_code_review_comments: All 4 bugs fixed were undefined variable references in RecordTransactionModal props - these would have caused runtime errors when opening the modal
Transaction recording feature consistently implemented across all 8 income forms + expense form
Insurance form has proper cascading selects for Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly frequency modes
All forms use correct data-testid attributes for testing reliability
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test transaction for business income 'grocery' with amount ₹2000 and note 'Test transaction from testing agent'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Transaction recording UI is now rolled out to all income forms (BusinessIncome, JobIncome, RentalIncome, SelfEmployedIncome, CommissionIncome, DividendIncome, InterestIncome, OtherIncomeForm) and ExpenseForm. The feature only appears in edit mode (when URL has ID parameter). Insurance form has cascading frequency selection working for Quarterly/Half-Yearly/Yearly modes. 4 bugs were fixed in RecordTransactionModal prop references.
